storyline.label: Claude Fable
storyline.latest_title: China's 2.8-trillion-parameter Kimi K3 beats Claude Fable 5 in Frontend Code Arena benchmark— Moonshot AI delivers largest open-weight AI model ever, as China works around U.S. compute limits - Tom's Hardware

prior_narrative.tldr: Anthropic launched Claude Fable 5 and the unguarded Mythos 5 in late June as long-horizon models "made safe for general use." A same-day companion post revealed a US export-control suspension had already been lifted, with a fresh redeploy starting July 1 alongside new cyber-safeguard classifiers and a first-draft jailbreak severity framework.
prior_narrative.whats_new: Anthropic published a Claude Cowork integration guide for Fable 5 on July 16 — positioning it for long, autonomous work inside Cowork — without addressing the still-open Max-plan access question.
prior_narrative.why_it_matters: Cowork is Anthropic's own long-running agent environment, so pairing it with Fable 5 signals where Anthropic expects unattended, multi-hour agent runs to actually happen — worth evaluating alongside the unresolved access-path question before committing workloads to it.

status.state: Enterprise trust deepening · Max-plan access still unresolved
status.detail: Fable 5 launched "made safe for general use" in late June with an export-control suspension already lifted; a July 5 hands-on report flagged Max access narrowing, and case studies since — a field guide, Cognition's eight-hour Devin run, Base44's, then a Cowork integration guide — show trust compounding without resolving the access question.

beats.headline: Claude Fable 5 + Mythos 5 ship — "made safe for general use"
beats.summary: Anthropic ships the Mythos-class Fable 5 and the unguarded Mythos 5, billed as made safe for general use.

beats.headline: Same-day post reveals the export-control suspension already lifted, redeploy starts July 1
beats.summary: Anthropic's companion post confirms a US export-control suspension has been lifted, with the model returning July 1 alongside new cyber-safeguard classifiers and a first-draft jailbreak severity framework.

beats.headline: Hands-on Fable 5 ships real code — but Max-plan access reportedly narrows
beats.summary: A builder uses Fable 5 to push sqlite-utils toward a 4.0 stable release, noting his Claude Max subscription's access to the model is closing within days.

beats.headline: Anthropic ships two builder guides: a general field guide, then a Cowork integration guide
beats.summary: A field guide on finding unknowns with Fable 5 (Jul 6), followed by a guide on running long autonomous work with Fable 5 inside Claude Cowork (Jul 16) — documentation, not a new status signal on the access question.

beats.headline: Cognition and Base44 both trust Fable 5 with their toughest engineering work
beats.summary: Two independent 'Working at the frontier' case studies in five days — Cognition's eight-hour unattended overnight Devin runs, then Base44's hardest product and engineering work — show enterprise trust compounding.

open_questions: Is the reported end of Fable 5 access on Claude Max subscriptions an official, product-wide change, and what happens after it?
Does the July 1 redeploy restore standard private-inference terms, or does a data-sharing requirement persist for any deployment path?
Is Fable 5 / Mythos 5 redeploying beyond Bedrock — first-party API or other clouds — on private-inference terms?
Do Cognition's and Base44's enterprise uses of Fable 5 run through access paths insulated from the reported Max-plan narrowing?
prior_narrative.take_for_builders: If you're piloting long unattended agent runs, check Cognition's eight-hour benchmark, Base44's engineering use, and the new Cowork guide — but confirm your own access path (API, Bedrock, or Max-plan) hasn't hit the reported narrowing first.

day_captions.fdd9745edc3aad4e: Same-day companion post: the export-control suspension has already been lifted, with redeploy starting July 1 and new cyber safeguards plus a jailbreak framework.
day_captions.ef10e0f5c9baeb91: First hands-on report of Fable 5 shipping real code, and the first signal that Max-subscription access may be ending within days.
day_captions.db18dd171266e42d: Anthropic ships builder-facing guidance for agentic coding with Fable 5, separate from the ongoing access-status thread.
day_captions.20fdad9da202b6cc: First reported eight-hour unattended production run — Cognition's Devin trusts Fable 5 overnight, a new adoption high point since the Max-access narrowing report.
day_captions.238d52a12c2e7d43: Second 'Working at the frontier' case study in five days — Base44 trusts Fable 5 with its hardest product and engineering work, reinforcing Cognition's July 10 signal.
day_captions.2bef8d685677b14e: Builder guidance on running Fable 5 for long, autonomous work inside Claude Cowork — documentation, not a new access-status signal.
